data_cutoff: inputs end 10-23 05:34:51 PKT (feature table) / 07:57 PKT (trades); nothing after 08:50 PKT was read
rule: BUY if (FINAL-2 live pick: ops/shadow/final_config2.json, unchanged) OR (GDM score >= threshold_top3 AND guards); then the become-them mechanics
fallback_model: L (use when token metadata is not available at bundle close)

mechanics.entry: right after the dev's glued bundle, only if first: price before our buy <= post-bundle price x 1.005
costs: pro: 0.6% overhead (+0.007 per 0.5 SOL fill), -0.003 per failed buy

label: yc: >= 10 distinct generic buyers (not one of the 321 sniper / 9 pro wallets, not dev/bundle) 2-10 s after the create
features_code: gdm/features.py (gdm_feats: walk-forward history from launches >= 10 min older; labels from gdm/labels_pass.py)
selection: config + cut chosen by the minimum over 4 time-ordered validation folds (R1 60-80%, R1 80-100%, R2 60-80%, R2 80-100%) of the mean (30/45 ms x t8/t10 x ps/ns) PRO-cost total: yc / LM / top 3% (gdm/cv_rows.json); then a 5-seed bag for stability (gdm/bag_eval.py)

wallet_lists.note: used by the label and the walk-forward history features (generic = not these, not dev/bundle)

forward_test: 1) labels_pass.py + features.py on the new launches (history = everything >= 10 min older, incl. R1/R2); 2) GDM score = bag mean with models[primary]; pick if score >= threshold_top3 and guards; 3) UNION with FINAL-2's live picks; 4) core/become_eval.py LANDS=30,45,75 guard 1.005, report slip / proafter_slip / nosnip at t8 (and t10), today + pro costs

LM.score: mean over bag of (F0 + lr * sum of tree leaves)

L.score: mean over bag of (F0 + lr * sum of tree leaves)
